RFC3032-2.1-1.note: {single-polarity: positive} covers only allocation. Asserted: AllocateLabel never returns below firstDynamicLabel, including across the MaxLabel wrap, so 0-15 is never allocated. The quote also states the Implicit NULL semantics: when the new label is 3 the LSR pops instead of swapping, and 3 never appears in the encapsulation. No tagged assertion covers a received label 3.
